ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a dominant distribution of low-intensity black pixels in the central region and high-intensity white pixels at the distal tips and scar sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes; the central field is primarily dark with high-frequency white mottling and linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate 40-50 degree angle; the vertex is partially obscured by surface water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible low-amplitude serrations and irregularities along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular and annular high-contrast clusters (white-on-black and black-on-white) visible on the right distal lobe and the upper mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear streaks and rake marks crossing the dark central pigmented areas, mostly oriented vertically and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive evidence of physical marks including circular barnacle attachment scars and multiple sets of linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dense cluster of circular white-ringed markings on the lower right distal region of the fluke.
